productionModel.formula: three Elf chassis + narrow stature band + lineage + identity
productionModel.headBodyRelation: project adult ~5–5.5-head band; do not create a separate tall-Elf ratio

bodyChassis.name: SLENDER LIGHT
bodyChassis.structuralRead: narrow/light adult Elf with long visual line

bodyChassis.name: STANDARD ELVEN
bodyChassis.structuralRead: baseline Elf frame; lighter/narrower than Human B02

bodyChassis.name: ATHLETIC
bodyChassis.structuralRead: trained/strong Elf while remaining lighter/narrower than Human B03

earGrammar.invariant: one ear construction system across all samples

invariants: longer visual line through lighter/narrower mass rather than head-size manipulation
one shared Elf skeleton across High/Wood/Drow
forbiddenMisreads: generic six-Elf board with no lineage coverage
green/bow/robe color stereotype used as lineage anatomy

rejection.imageCandidate: first generated VA03-ELF Body Chassis Diagnostic
reasons: board treated Elf too much as Human + pointed ears
no explicit Drow / High Elf / Wood Elf lineage coverage despite repository research requirement
E05 broad/soft mass drifted toward Human broad/heavy construction and violated Elf long-line/light-mass core
E03/E04 athletic construction drifted too close to Human strong chassis
hair diversity became over-styled and dominated species read
high-volume curls / buns were introduced by project prompt constraints, not by repository Elf canon
rejection.rule: Reject current image. Do not use it as a positive Elf reference.

lineages.rule: all lineages share one Elf species skeleton; lineage must not create a new anatomy system

repositoryGuidance.HighElf: later behavior may express scholarly/magical identity; do not require ornate robes
repositoryGuidance.WoodElf: later behavior/environment may express outdoor identity; do not rely on green clothing or bows
repositoryGuidance.Drow: preserve Elf skeleton; do not render as another species

forbidden: hair gimmicks designed only to expose ears
